I just got back from the 2024 DECA International Career Development Conference. It's still a little surreal to think about. After three years of participating in the Hospitality and Tourism Professional Selling event internationally, this year I took a leap into the unknown and decided to try out the Marketing Communications Series event instead, competing against some of the most talented high schoolers in the world. My risk paid off - I won first place out of more than 1200 competitors! That's not even the best part. In past years, my chapter has never earned more than two top-three placements in any given year, and we have also never won first place in any event. This year, we took away a grand total of SEVEN placements with FIVE first-place trophies. In all honesty, it looks like we set the chapter record! It's absolutely INCREDIBLE - we were all blown away. I'm so proud of everyone. It's all a bit bittersweet, though. ICDC 2024 was my last-ever high school DECA conference, and it's only just fully hit me that transitioning to college means I'll never again get to step into a competition hall ready to start roleplay prep or wait anxiously at the edge of my seat to find out if I'll get called up on stage as a top ten performer. DECA is one of my absolute favorite things, and my experience with it has been unforgettable. I'll treasure all these memories for a long time yet. In the meantime, on to bigger and better things! Perhaps I'll be a DECA judge next year. Who knows? #DECA #ICDC

Hey LinkedIn community! We're thrilled to share one of the amazing outcomes of our recent philanthropic hackathon, "Code for Cause." We organized this event with the mission of providing technical support to local organizations. One of our proud collaborations was with BISV DECA! The winning team at our hackathon made an easy-to-use and intuitive app to help streamline BISV DECA's meeting attendance system. After the event, we worked hand-in-hand with the BISV DECA team and the Code for Cause winning team to help the organization get set up and use the app in club operations. Today, we're thrilled to celebrate the successful implementation of the app, making a real difference in optimizing their processes. It's inspiring to see technology catalyze positive change, and we're honored to be part of BISV DECA's journey toward greater efficiency and impact. 🌍💪 A big shoutout to the entire team for their dedication and to BISV DECA for embracing innovation! 🎉 Let's continue making strides together! #CodeForCause #TechForGood #Collaboration #ImpactfulInnovation #BISVDECA
